package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted = "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1"

// DiagnosticResultCommittedData carries references only. The authoritative
// aggregate remains behind Student's dedicated Planner HTTP boundary.
type DiagnosticResultCommittedData struct {
	PlanID       string `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision int    `json:"plan_revision"`
	PlanDigest   string `json:"plan_digest"`
	ResultDigest string `json:"result_digest"`
}

func DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(planID string) string {
	return uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted+":"+planID)).String()
}

func NewDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(result DiagnosticAssessmentResult, completionRequestID string) (IntegrationEvent, error) {
	result, err := NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentResult(result)
	if err != nil || result.AttemptID != result.PlanID || !validDiagnosticUUID(completionRequestID) {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return NewIntegrationEvent(DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(result.PlanID), SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted,
		result.PlanID, completionRequestID, result.StudentID, result.CompletedAt, 1,
		DiagnosticResultCommittedData{result.PlanID, result.PlanRevision, result.PlanDigest, result.ResultDigest})
}

// ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent protects the relay from malformed or
// misbound stored payloads before any publication. The limit is independent of
// the database's JSON representation and permits only the exact reference data.
func ValidateDiagnosticResultCommittedEvent(event IntegrationEvent) error {
	if event.Subject != SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted || len(event.Payload) == 0 || len(event.Payload) > 8192 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(event.Payload))
	if err := diagnosticEventObject(dec, 0); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err := dec.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	var envelope EventEnvelope
	if err := decodeDiagnosticEvent(event.Payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	var data DiagnosticResultCommittedData
	if err := decodeDiagnosticEvent(envelope.Data, &data); err != nil || !validDiagnosticUUID(data.PlanID) || data.PlanRevision < 1 || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(data.PlanDigest) || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(data.ResultDigest) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	if envelope.EventType != SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted || envelope.SchemaVersion != 1 || envelope.EventID != DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(data.PlanID) || envelope.CorrelationID != data.PlanID || !validDiagnosticUUID(envelope.StudentID) || !validDiagnosticUUID(envelope.CausationID) || !canonicalDiagnosticTimestamp(envelope.OccurredAt) ||
		event.EventID != envelope.EventID || event.SchemaVersion != envelope.SchemaVersion || event.StudentID != envelope.StudentID || event.CorrelationID != envelope.CorrelationID || event.CausationID != envelope.CausationID || !event.OccurredAt.Equal(envelope.OccurredAt) {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

func decodeDiagnosticEvent(raw []byte, target any) error {
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := dec.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}

// The event has exactly two object levels and scalar values. Token inspection
// rejects duplicate keys before Go's ordinary decoder could overwrite them.
func diagnosticEventObject(dec *json.Decoder, depth int) error {
	if depth > 1 {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	opening, err := dec.Token()
	if err != nil || opening != json.Delim('{') {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for dec.More() {
		token, err := dec.Token()
		key, ok := token.(string)
		if err != nil || !ok || seen[key] {
			return ErrValidation
		}
		if depth == 0 {
			switch key {
			case "event_id", "event_type", "correlation_id", "causation_id", "student_id", "occurred_at", "schema_version", "data":
			default:
				return ErrValidation
			}
		} else {
			switch key {
			case "plan_id", "plan_revision", "plan_digest", "result_digest":
			default:
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
		seen[key] = true
		if depth == 0 && key == "data" {
			if err := diagnosticEventObject(dec, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		} else {
			value, err := dec.Token()
			if _, composite := value.(json.Delim); err != nil || composite || value == nil {
				return ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	closing, err := dec.Token()
	if err != nil || closing != json.Delim('}') {
		return ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
